title: Unseal

description.en: Find quarantined macOS apps and interactively remove their quarantine flags.
description.zh: 扫描被 macOS 隔离的应用，交互式地批量解除隔离标记。

subject.en: An opened green enamel and brass padlock
subject.zh: 刚刚开启的绿珐琅黄铜挂锁

description.en: A complete brass shackle lifts and turns above a substantial green padlock. The torn red paper seal stays attached as one restrained accent.
description.zh: 完整黄铜锁梁从厚实绿色锁身上抬起并转开。撕开的红色纸封仍贴着侧面，形成克制的单一兴趣点。

title.zh: 旧黄铜与鼠尾草绿珐琅

description.en: Soft metal wear, curved enamel and the physical keyhole make the object tangible. The open shackle is unmistakable even without a separate key or symbol.
description.zh: 柔和金属磨损、弧面珐琅和真实锁眼带来触感；无需钥匙或附加符号，也能清楚识别解锁状态。

description.en: Separated perforated seams and folded-tab outlines embossed in calm sage paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 鼠尾草色纸面的分离虚线与折页轮廓，呼应解除封印。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the open shackle, green body and red seal remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认打开的锁梁、绿色锁身和红纸封；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Review quarantine results for apps in /Applications and select trusted apps for batch removal of the quarantine attribute.
goal.zh: 查看 /Applications 内应用的隔离检测结果，选择可信应用后批量移除隔离属性。

description.en: Separated perforations and folded-tab outlines suggest a seal that has just been opened.
description.zh: 断开的齿孔线与翻起的封签轮廓，留下封条刚被打开的轻巧痕迹。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥79px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 79px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
